messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: It is not known whether this risk continues beyond about four months of treatment. There is good evidence that antidepressants delay depression coming back in adults, and depression itself raises the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
Anyone taking sertraline should be watched closely for worsening symptoms and for new or sudden changes in mood, behavior, thoughts, or feelings, especially in the first few months of treatment and whenever the dose is changed. Call your healthcare provider right away, or call 911 in an emergency, if you notice:
- thoughts about suicide or dying, or attempts to harm yourself
- new or worse depression, anxiety, or panic attacks
- feeling agitated, restless, angry, or irritable
- acting aggressive or violent, or acting on dangerous impulses
- trouble sleeping
- a big increase in activity or talking more than is normal for you
- any other unusual change in behavior or mood
Tell family members or caregivers which symptoms to watch for, so they can call your provider if you are not able to.
Triples: [["sertraline", "has unknown risk duration", "beyond four months of treatment"], ["sertraline", "increases risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors", "depression"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring for", "worsening symptoms"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring for", "new or sudden changes in mood"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring for", "new or sudden changes in behavior"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring for", "new or sudden changes in thoughts"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring for", "new or sudden changes in feelings"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring during", "first few months of treatment"], ["sertraline", "requires close monitoring when", "dose is changed"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "thoughts about suicide or dying or attempts to harm self"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "new or worse depression"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "anxiety"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "panic attacks"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "feeling agitated"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "restlessness"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "anger"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "irritability"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "acting aggressive or violent"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "acting on dangerous impulses"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "trouble sleeping"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "big increase in activity"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "talking more than normal"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "unusual change in behavior or mood"], ["sertraline", "requires patient instruction", "call healthcare provider right away if symptoms are observed"], ["sertraline", "requires patient instruction", "call 911 in emergency if symptoms are observed"], ["sertraline", "requires patient instruction", "tell family members or caregivers which symptoms to watch for"], ["sertraline", "requires patient instruction", "family members or caregivers should call provider if patient is unable to report symptoms"]]
Relations: ["has unknown risk duration", "has warning", "increases risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors", "requires close monitoring during", "requires close monitoring for", "requires close monitoring when", "requires patient instruction"]
Answer:

completion:
has unknown risk duration: The risk associated with the subject drug is not known to continue beyond the specified duration of treatment.  
has warning: The subject drug is associated with the specified symptoms or conditions, which require immediate attention or action by the patient or caregiver.  
increases risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors: The subject drug may elevate the likelihood of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in individuals who have the specified condition.  
requires close monitoring during: The subject drug necessitates vigilant observation of the patient during the specified time period.  
requires close monitoring for: The subject drug requires continuous observation for the specified symptoms or changes.  
requires close monitoring when: The subject drug necessitates vigilant observation of the patient at the specified event or condition.  
requires patient instruction: The patient or caregiver must be informed of specific actions to take if certain symptoms or conditions are observed.
